𝟭𝟳𝟭* — 𝗛𝗔𝗥𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗣𝗥𝗘𝗘𝗧 𝗛𝗜𝗧𝗦 𝗕𝗔𝗖𝗞 🔥

Harmanpreet Kaur, 171* off 115 vs Australia, 2017 World Cup semi-final, Derby.
20 fours, 7 sixes. India won by 36 runs and reached the final. 🇮🇳
